---
title: Pop Up Banner
description: >-
  Create eye-catching, full-screen announcements by uploading pop-up graphics,
  specifying display start and end times, and redirecting users via customized
  action buttons.
---
<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="1374" height="759" style="width: 1374px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

## Step

1. Navigate to Loyalty App > Pop Up Banner > Add Pop Up Banner.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="313" height="193" style="width: 313px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

2. Insert pop up banner image. Enter the title and description.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="416" height="244" style="width: 416px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

3. Pick the start and end dates.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="356" height="328" style="width: 356px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />
